result:
I’d give people a deeper, more reliable capacity for empathy.

Not just fleeting sympathy, but the ability to genuinely understand perspectives different from their own—especially when they disagree. If that changed, so many other things would improve: conflict resolution, politics, inequality, education, even how we treat the planet. Most harm isn’t caused by pure malice; it’s caused by distance—distance from other people’s pain, needs, and humanity.

If that gap narrowed, I think the world would become much more repairable.
